title: Quantity Stepper
summary: Holds suspicious quantity jumps for a "Did you mean 10?" check and clamps to stock with a reason, so an accidental bulk order isn't placed.
description: Quantity stepper that clamps to min, max and stock with an explanation, rounds to pack sizes, holds big typed jumps for a "Did you mean 10?" confirmation, ignores the scroll wheel and accelerates on long-press.
catches: Typed jumps far above the typical quantity (100 when people order 2)
Values over max or stock, clamped with a reason
Quantities that aren't a whole pack (step)
Scroll-wheel changes while scrolling the page
limits: "Suspicious" is relative to your typical prop
Stock shown is what you pass; it may be stale
a11y: Visible label; the input is a spinbutton with min, max and now values, described by a hint
+/- buttons have aria-labels and aria-controls, and are skipped in tab order
server: Validate quantity against live stock and order limits on the server.
